description: The look rows (default empty) — authored appearances the population wears, the peer of Kits (see WorldLook). Empty resolves every entity to the implicit single catalog look.

items.description: One look row — the appearance peer of WorldKit's way of moving. Every appearance a world offers is a row of this data, never a renderer branch; world.looks prints these names.

name.description: The look's stable kebab-case name (unique within the definition), assignable by the look table.

source.description: Where the appearance resolves from (a catalog rig or a creation).

anyOf.description: The procedural humanoid catalog (WorldAvatarCatalog) — one look source among others.

index.description: The procedural renderer catalog rig to pin, or null for the index-derived pick.

anyOf.description: A sculpted creation worn by the body — resolved against the world's WorldCreation rows.

creationId.description: The referenced Id (must resolve at validation).

scale.description: The uniform render scale. Appearance only — it does not resize the body's motion tuning or its collision volume.

motion.description: How the look animates with the body (see WorldLookMotion).

gaitAmplitude.description: The catalog rig's limb-swing scale (1 = the pre-look default; 0 stills the gait).

replayFrames.description: Whether a creation look replays its authored timeline on the render clock.

secondsPerFrame.description: The creation timeline cadence when ReplayFrames is set.
